keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
The company's business model integrates traditional, Vedic, and cultural elements with modern technology to enhance customers' livelihoods. It offers a variety of services such as Homam, Puja, Pariharam, and Samskaram, addressing aspects like wealth, health, career, education, love, marriage, finance, and other remedial services. Currently, the company is also involved in developing high-class infrastructure to promote health sports tourism and provide extensive facilities for corporate businesses.
